title: Merge a pull request

summary:
Sent when you confirm Merge, with Bloom's own merge steps under it and the project's own instructions attached when it has any. The agent runs `gh pr merge` in front of you, not Bloom.

variables:
- workspace: The workspace's name.
- number: The pull request's number.
- title: The pull request's title.
- branch: The branch it is on.
- base_branch: The branch it is merged into.
- method: The method you chose, in words: squash merge, merge commit, rebase merge.
- method_flag: The same method as the gh flag that performs it, such as --squash.

template:
Merge pull request #{{number}} into {{base_branch}} as a {{method}}, which is `{{method_flag}}`. It is on the branch {{branch}}.
